evidence_records.title: India Macroeconomic & GDP Growth Intelligence
evidence_records.source_authority: World Bank & Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: World Bank WDI data subject to periodic benchmark revisions and base-year rebasing (currently 2011-12 series). Constant US$ values adjust for inflation; purchasing power parity comparisons use separate conversion factors.

evidence_records.title: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Inflation & Monetary Policy Monitor
evidence_records.source_authority: Reserve Bank of India (RBI DBIE) & MoSPI CPI
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: MoSPI Headline CPI Combined uses 2012=100 base index. Policy repo rate corresponds to RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) bi-monthly resolution outcomes. Real interest rate is calculated as Repo Rate minus Headline CPI.

evidence_records.title: India State-Level Demographics & Census Analytics
evidence_records.source_authority: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Census 2011 represents the most recent decennial official count. 2021 Census was deferred due to COVID-19 pandemic; figures represent verified official baseline benchmarks across 36 States & UTs.

evidence_records.title: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) State Health Monitor
evidence_records.source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / IIPS Mumbai
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: NFHS-5 survey was conducted in two phases (2019-20 and 2020-21) across 707 districts. Stunting and wasting metrics use WHO 2006 Child Growth Standards (< -2 SD).

evidence_records.title: India Agricultural Production & Crop Yield Analytics
evidence_records.source_authority: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Agricultural statistics from Directorate of Economics & Statistics reflect Final Estimates for historical years and 4th Advance Estimates for the latest completed crop year (July to June cycle).

evidence_records.title: India Power Generation & Renewable Energy Transition
evidence_records.source_authority: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) / Ministry of Power / MNRE
evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Central Electricity Authority capacity metrics reflect grid-connected utility power. Captive and rooftop solar installations are reported under distinct supplementary statistical statements.

evidence_records.title: India Foreign Trade & Merchandise Export-Import Intelligence

evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Ministry of Commerce trade merchandise data excludes cross-border trade in services (reported separately by RBI in balance of payments). Exchange rates reflect RBI annual reference rates.

evidence_records.title: India Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Inflows & Equity Trends

evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: DPIIT FDI statistics report gross equity inflows and exclude reinvested earnings and other capital until reconciled in RBI Annual BOP statistics. Routing via Singapore/Mauritius reflects bilateral tax treaty structures.

evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Indian Railways traffic statements report originating revenue-earning freight. Operating ratio reflects gross working expenditure as a proportion of gross traffic receipts.

evidence_records.authenticity_tier: Tier-1 Sovereign / Multilateral Official Primary Source
evidence_records.data_limitations_and_methodology: Open-Meteo European atmospheric dispersion model calibrated against CPCB official AQI breakpoints. Hourly readings capture ground-level microclimate variations across 10 metropolitan centers.
